Blount County is a ridge-and-valley county on Birmingham's northeastern edge, with Oneonta as its seat and covered bridges as its signature. It functions increasingly as a commuter county — subdivisions follow Highway 75 and I-65 access at its western edge — while poultry farms and orchards still hold most of the land.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: October 5, 2026
